sentences.text:
Criminal Revision No. 516
/ 1997
1. Mool Chand S/o Asu Ram, by caste Sharma, resident of Pokran House, Loco Road, Jodhpur.
2. Hanuman Prasad S/o Sri Krishna by caste Jangid, resident of Pokran House, Loco Road,
Jodhpur.

----Petitioner Versus The State of Rajasthan.
----Respondent _____________________________________________________ For
Petitioner(s) : Mr.Vinit Jain For Respondent(s) : Mr.J.P.Bhardwaj, Public Prosecutor.
The petitioners were convicted for an offence punishable under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
The decision by the learned Magistrate is dated 20.8.1996.

Both of them have been sentenced to undergo SI for a period of one year and pay fine in sum of 2000/-
each.

2. The case of the prosecution is that a sample of mustered oil was taken from Laxmi Kirana Store and Public Analyst found it to be adulterated inasmuch as it did not conform to the prescribed standards.
3. Apart from other issues, an issue of notice contemplated by Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 being served upon the petitioners was urged.
The learned Magistrate held that the notice was served.

In the appeal filed vide (2 of 2) [CRLR-516/1997] impugned decision dated 20.10.1997 the learned Court of Session has held that from the evidence on record it was not proved that the notice contemplated by Section 13(2) was served.

The conviction and sentence has been set aside but with remand to the learned trial court with direction that upon compliance being made with Section 13(2) of the PFA Act the petitioners would be entitled to have a second opinion from the Central Food Laboratory.
4.

The grievance of the petitioners is to the matter being remanded inasmuch as even when the appeal was decided on 20.10.1997, 4 years and 3 months had passed by when the samples were drawn the date being 16.7.1993.
The samples would have been deteriorated even by then.
There is merit in the contention advanced.
